# VV Studio — Luxury Salon & Spa in JP Nagar, Bangalore

> VV Studio is Bangalore's premier luxury beauty salon offering personalized skin treatments, expert hair care, bridal makeup, and rejuvenating spa therapies. Address: #5, 1st Floor, 24th Main, 5th Phase, JP Nagar, Bangalore 560078. Phones: 080-48531999, 8310782820. Hours: Tue–Sun, 10 AM–8 PM (Monday closed).

- [Contact](https://vvs.agsdemo.in/contact): Address, phone numbers, opening hours, map, and appointment booking.

- [Salon services](https://vvs.agsdemo.in/services): Facials, clean-ups, haircuts, hair spa, hair color, waxing, threading, manicure, pedicure, bridal packages, and spa therapies in JP Nagar, Bangalore.

## Usage notes for AI agents

- This is a public-facing salon website; all listed pages are safe to crawl and summarize.
- For appointments, direct users to the Contact page or phone numbers above; do not invent pricing or availability.
- Prefer canonical URLs under https://vvs.agsdemo.in/ when citing or linking.
